name: format
summary: Render structured facts and a summary into a fixed-section markdown rollout status report.
description: Fifth node of the report.* chain. Formats structured_facts and summary_or_translation into a deterministic markdown report with fixed sections: title (# Rollout Status Report), Project line (or '(unnamed)' when missing/blank), Insights (N) bullets in input order, and a Summary block containing the summary verbatim. Single trailing newline; identical input yields identical bytes. Pure, deterministic, memory-only.

use_cases.scenario: As a rollout coordinator, I want named project facts and a summary folded into one markdown report, so that stakeholders receive a stable rollout status document.

output_example.report:
# Rollout Status Report
Project: Acme Rollout
Insights (2):
- Fact: browser — up
- Fact: edge — warm
Summary:
Acme looks healthy.

use_cases.scenario: As a rollout coordinator, I want missing project names to render as (unnamed), so that the report template stays valid when upstream nodes omit the field.

output_example.report:
# Rollout Status Report
Project: (unnamed)
Insights (1):
- alpha
Summary:
s

use_cases.scenario: As a rollout coordinator, I want zero structured facts to still produce Insights (0) with no bullets, so that an empty enrichment stage does not invent insight lines.

output_example.report:
# Rollout Status Report
Project: Acme
Insights (0):
Summary:
Nothing to report.

preconditions.description: Caller supplies structured_facts array and summary_or_translation string (either may be empty); project_name is optional.

postconditions.description: Identical input always yields an identical report string with fixed section order, stable whitespace, and a single trailing newline. Formatting uses no randomness, clocks, or host state.

side_effects.description: Produces one report string in memory; does not log, persist, or transmit inputs.
